sites.why: Rule 8: LLM.ask non-streaming chat.completions.create on AsyncOpenAI(api_key, base_url) built from operator config/config.toml [llm] (falls back to shipped config.example.toml whose base_url is api.anthropic.com/v1/); operator key; model from config at runtime and repo literals include catalog ids (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, o1, o3-mini). Same call also serves the AsyncAzureOpenAI (api_type=azure) and BedrockClient shim (api_type=aws) branches, which must stay as-is.
Rule 8: LLM.ask streaming chat.completions.create(stream=True), same config-driven AsyncOpenAI client, operator key, runtime model.
Rule 8: LLM.ask_with_images non-streaming chat.completions.create with image_url content, config-driven client, operator key, runtime model.
Rule 8: LLM.ask_with_images streaming chat.completions.create (stream in params), config-driven client, operator key, runtime model.
Rule 8: LLM.ask_tool chat.completions.create with tools/tool_choice/timeout (agent loop hot path), config-driven client, operator key, runtime model.
Rule 2: boto3 bedrock-runtime converse (BedrockClient shim used when [llm] api_type=aws); Bedrock endpoint, AWS credentials from environment.
Rule 2: boto3 bedrock-runtime converse_stream (streaming branch of the Bedrock shim); Bedrock endpoint.

Rule 7: new VMind({url: `${base_url}/chat/completions`, model, headers: Bearer api_key}) - third-party @visactor/vmind library does raw HTTP chat-completions POSTs (generateChart/getInsights) to the [llm] base_url passed from data_visualization.py (default config: api.anthropic.com/v1/chat/completions). Shipped DataVisualization tool (DataAnalysis agent, run_flow). Library-internal request shape cannot be rewritten mechanically; counted once at the construction.
